row:
Public policy, state politics and legislative coverage from Kentucky Educational Television.

Through programs like Kentucky Edition, Kentucky Tonight and Comment on Kentucky, KET’s public affairs coverage takes viewers beyond the headlines and fosters civil conversations that encourage greater understanding of the complex issues facing our state and nation.
